en.headline: Election Committee nomination period opens with 307 forms
en.dek: Returning officers received 305 candidate forms and two designated-body forms on the first day, with nominations open until 20 October.
body: Returning officers for the 2026 Election Committee subsector ordinary election received 307 nomination forms on the first day of the nomination period, the government said.
Of those, 305 were candidate nomination forms and two were designated-body nomination forms. The nomination period opened on Wednesday and runs until 20 October.

The Election Committee chooses the Chief Executive and nominates members of the Legislative Council. The government said the forms were received by the returning officers of the various subsectors during Wednesday's business.

Sing Tao Daily, citing the first-day tally, reported that the labour subsector received 60 candidate forms, the most of any subsector, followed by agriculture and fisheries with 46. The paper also reported 28 forms for the Heung Yee Kuk and 17 for the tourism subsector.

zh.headline: 選委會提名期首日接獲307份表格
zh.dek: 政府表示，各選舉主任星期三接獲305份候選人提名表格及兩份指定團體提名表格，提名期至10月20日。
body: 政府公布，2026年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉提名期首日，各選舉主任共接獲307份提名表格。
當中305份為候選人提名表格，另外兩份為指定團體提名表格。提名期由星期三開始，至10月20日結束。
選委會負責選出行政長官，並提名立法會選舉委員會界別議員。政府指，有關表格是各界別分組選舉主任在星期三辦公時間內接獲。
星島日報引述首日數字報道，勞工界接獲60份候選人提名表格，為各分組最多，漁農界接獲46份；鄉議局接獲28份，旅遊界接獲17份。
